About half of the tickets for "MAX-A-MILLION" are sold. The top prize count has held, with twelve of 25 still unclaimed. The number of tickets printed is fixed, so that is a plain good sign.

The numbers for "MAX-A-MILLION" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
985.headline: Top prizes are still left

988.body:
"Emerald 10's" has two of five top prizes left and is in the second half of its run. About two-thirds of the tickets are already sold. As a game goes on, the same prizes are spread across fewer tickets. Right now, tickets are selling faster than top prizes are being claimed, which is good for the tickets that are left.

Everything above about "Emerald 10's" comes from the North Carolina Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
988.headline: How far along this game is

990.body:
Of all the tickets printed for "LADY LUCK", about a quarter are still unsold. The game is well into its run, with two of four top prizes unclaimed. In every scratcher, either the tickets or the prizes run out first. The rest of this page shows the details.

If you play "LADY LUCK" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
990.headline: Early stage or late

992.body:
About three-quarters of the tickets for "$2 MILLION VAULT" have been sold. The game is past the halfway point of its run. The key question is whether the tickets or the top prizes run out first. Right now, a larger share of the top prizes is left than of the tickets, which is a good sign.

Everything here about "$2 MILLION VAULT" comes from official North Carolina lottery numbers, current through October 11.
992.headline: How far along this game is

993.body:
"$5,000 Triple Play" has had no $5,000 top prize claimed for four months. Everyday prizes keep getting claimed, and fewer tickets are left each day. The number of tickets printed is fixed. Each day without a top prize claim leaves those prizes among fewer tickets.

The numbers for "$5,000 Triple Play" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
993.headline: Top prizes have lasted so far

994.body:
"$25,000 Triple Play" has 111,698 prizes of $2 still unclaimed, which is its most common win. Just below the top prize is the $3,000 prize, with three left. The full count for every prize level is listed below.

If "$25,000 Triple Play" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
